summary.zh: 按计划把每个任务交给独立子代理实现与复查
summary.en: Run each plan task through a fresh implementer and reviewer.

description.zh: 执行实现计划时，把每个任务交给全新上下文的子代理落地，再由另一位子代理评审，主会话只做协调和汇合。适合任务边界清晰、需要独立复查的多步开发。需要运行环境支持子代理。
description.en: Each task in the plan goes to a subagent with a fresh context, then to a separate reviewer, while the main session coordinates and merges. Suits multi-step work with clear task boundaries. Requires subagent support in the runtime.
